title: Teacher–Student Distillation for Efficient Road-Event Recognition
status: protocol fixed before new final evaluation
independence: New post-defense COMP 765 student study; thesis CSEB is a fixed teacher. Prior pilot and expanded runs are historical context only.
student: Same ResNet50 throughlayer3 + sceneGRU256/head as original; stem/layer1/layer2 frozen; layer3 frozen versus trainable. All BatchNorm running statistics fixed; layer3 BN affine weights train only in tuned arms.
teacher: Fixed CSEB attention-global-dcb-seed0, 1B InternVideo2 visual encoder, classification/DCB and contrastive/DCB experts, composition blend weight0.5; current minus3 through plus4 at10Hz
objective: Mean BCEWithLogits over all proposal/class entries in each32-frame sequence, outputs1:184; supervised BCE plus kd_weight times BCE to independent teacher sigmoid probabilities; no softmax or temperature. Output0 excluded from both losses.
teacher_targets: Fresh teacher scores on intended training candidates only; remove detector confidence once to recover probabilities, set unused slot0=1; reuse hash-verified original8-frame training cache where exact inputs match. No teacher target generation on selection/final inputs.
optimizer: AdamW; headlr0.001, trainablelayer3lr0.00001, weight_decay0.01; gradientnormclip5 over all trainable parameters
batch_unit: one32-frame contiguous video sequence; average over proposals and183 outputs; same64 sequences per epoch for both conditions
initialization: ImageNetV2 layer3 and exact original per-seed random head initialization; all four conditions paired at initialization and data order. No warmstart from AP-selected prior models.
selection: Minimum supervised development BCE over30 epochs, first epoch wins ties; unchanged probability-clipped BCE from existing student; no final evaluation tuning
splits: Exact expanded64 training videos and12 selection videos; original start frames retained; final198 official validation videos. Explicit lists in split-manifest.json. Historical12-video student holdout excluded from new selection and final.
history_disclosure: Official198validationvideos previously used for sharedYOLO validation/checkpoint selection and thesis research. Disjoint only from teacher/student semantic-head training/selection. Not independent full-system test.
training_state: Zero at each32-frame segment; full32-frame BPTT; no future student inputs. Unannotated frames update scene state with empty actor inputs; excluded from both objectives, never treated as negatives.
evaluation_state: Zero at each video boundary; process every image from frame1 to final scored frame at10Hz, including unscored frames with empty actors; never reset at annotation gaps. Score only locked36717 frames;38663 total recurrent steps.
feature_precision: Frozen stem/layer1/layer2 outputs cached in exact bfloat16; layer3 encodes32 independent frames together underbf16 autocast; fixed BN statistics prevent cross-frame normalization. RoIAlign float32, pooled features roundfloat16 thenfloat32. Full32-frame recurrent BPTT. Runtime uses one current frame. Fresh frozen controls use same batched training features.
evaluation_candidates: Exact historical dets_v8x_best_val_fullcand.pkl, 6163968 candidates, candidate_sha256 fc84d73fdaa7b4f74ea2694aa54f3b4a1069f4b6d45276f2df5e9c5374378cb2. This lower-threshold fixed-candidate evaluation differs from liveconf0.25; no causal detector AP claim for the live policy.
score_assembly: sigmoid outputs multiplied by detector confidence exactly once; slot0 overwritten by confidence; official agent AP uses detector class and confidence, unchanged shared metric.py
primary_endpoint: Paired tuned-distilled minus frozen-distilled official detector triplet mAP atIoU0.5 over86classes
secondary_endpoints: KD effect within frozen and tuned students
All standard groups and per-class AP
frequency_groups: Fixed authoritative train-counts.json,600 training videos, standardizedlog10 counts across86 classes; never validation frequencies
analysis: Three paired seeds; mean/sampleSD and paired-t95 df2 for prespecified contrasts. Include all outcomes. Exploratory follow-up on reused benchmark; no final-AP tuning or adaptive stopping.
teacher_accuracy_comparator: Reuse verified exact-checkpoint official detector result only after matching checkpoint hash, frame/candidate hashes, labels, metric/core hashes. Teacher temporal inputs differ; accuracy gap is descriptive.
runtime: Prespecified tuned-distilled seed0 export compared with fresh frozen-distilled seed0; same raw video/candidates,4warmup+32measured frames; continuous isolation/causal/memory checks. No automatic replacement of existing demo bundle.
runtime_videos: First3 training videos in frozen split ordering; benchmarking uses training data only; no runtime-based accuracy selection
scope_limitations: Fresh frozen controls because training feature batching and precision path changed; historical ResNet results contextual only
GPU RoIAlign backward may be nondeterministic; exact RNG/optimizer restoration plus numeric resume tolerance reported
Frozen BatchNorm statistics; layer3 affine parameters learn only in tuned arms
No hyperparameter search against official AP; no data expansion or architecture swap
Teacher future-window supervision; causal student inference
Benchmark exposure and different timing/AP candidate policies retained
preservation: Do not modify thesis, slides, historical checkpoints/results, v1 realtime bundle; no automatic model promotion
prefix_cache: Temporary /dev/shm exactbfloat16 outputs, all76 sequences preloaded toGPU; ~10.91GiB. Regenerate with prepare.py after reboot. Source images and receipt hashes preserved.
